the last envelope

A letter for you

Today isn't only about another year. It is about every little version of you that kept going, kept dreaming, kept becoming.

I hope you look around this year and find more moments that make you say, “I’m glad I’m here.” More people who celebrate your softness. More mornings that feel hopeful. More evenings that feel peaceful.

And when life gets noisy, I hope you remember this: you don't have to be perfect to be extraordinary. You only have to keep being you.

So make a wish. Close your eyes. Breathe in all the good things that are still coming.
